note: A line from the input file is read into buf and linep points at the attacker-controlled public suffix rule.
The parser advances over the non-whitespace rule bytes so the whole UTF-8 domain rule is selected.
The input-controlled rule pointer and length are passed to suffix_init for storage in a psl_entry_t.
suffix_init copies the accepted non-ASCII rule into suffix.label_buf, preserving it for IDNA conversion.
The non-ASCII label_buf is supplied to psl_idna_toASCII, where the punycode/ASCII form can become larger than the fixed stack buffers.

code: utf16_dst_length = uidna_nameToASCII((UIDNA *)idna, utf16_src, utf16_src_length, utf16_dst, countof(utf16_dst), &info, &status);
note: The code provides a fixed 128-UChar destination for an input-controlled IDNA result without first requiring that the converted name fit in utf16_dst.

code: utf16_dst_length = uidna_nameToASCII((UIDNA *)idna, utf16_src, utf16_src_length, utf16_dst, countof(utf16_dst), &info, &status);
note: ICU writes the converted ASCII name into the 128-element stack buffer utf16_dst; an expanded IDNA output exceeding that capacity causes the stack-buffer-overflow write.
